Q. Q. 1 لَهْوَجَ أَمْرَهُ (inf. n. لَهْوَجَةٌ, S) (tropical:) He performed, executed, or managed, his affairs in an unsound manner. (AZ, S, K.) ―
-b2- لَهْوَجَ He cooked roast meat insufficiently, or not thoroughly: (K:) or he cooked roast meat, (K,) or flesh-meat, (S,) not well; (S, K;) as also ↓ تَلَهْوَجَ . (S.) See 1.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
